prediction.rationale: The badge reads only the active count. Per-ID signals update selection attributes directly, so selecting a row runs no row constructors. Keys preserve the editor node through refetch and swap, and focus and caret are restored if moving the node blurs it. Each open picker has one library wiring instance, which is disposed on close.
